reason: A DSH web plugin that monitors MiniMax token-plan quotas and presents usage, reset timing, and model details in an adaptive dock.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中显示 MiniMax 各模型的 5 小时与每周配额使用情况、重置倒计时及详细数据。
summaries.en: Displays MiniMax model quota usage, reset countdowns, and detailed 5-hour and weekly statistics in the DSH web interface.

capabilities: Reads MiniMax token-plan quota data through an upstream API
Uses a user-provided MiniMax API key for authenticated requests
Periodically polls quota data and exposes local HTTP endpoints
Displays quota percentages, reset countdowns, and absolute usage values in the DSH web interface
